investigation: M5R — Native Reference Convergence and Reconstruction Quality Investigation

full32Vs64.channelScope: RGBA includes the equal constant alpha channel; RGB excludes alpha.

cap2.channelScope: Existing fields are RGBA including equal constant alpha; rgbOnly excludes alpha.

A.repeatabilityAssertion: The original M5R run recorded exact output comparisons but did not assert them; see reviewFix1 for the fail-closed revalidation.

B.conclusion: Relative gradient metric is floor-inflated, but absolute differences remain. Meaningful fallback support is only six pixels and reference convergence is unresolved; no general visible B1 halo is established.

C.classification: registered-application-support-limited; controlled native silhouette demonstrates M5 TSL fractional coverage and foreground spread
C.conclusion: App state lacks accepted off-center samples; GPU, CPU and binary16 agree. Controlled silhouette confirms actual Near TSL fractional alpha and spread, but only as fixture evidence.

rootCauseMatrix.experiment: Repeated native captures; matched-count independent CPU references; CPU32/64/128/256 ROI sequence.
rootCauseMatrix.supporting: The Review Fix 1 native run asserted exact same-profile repeats and matched-count GPU/CPU conformance; CPU tier differences decrease through 256 samples.
rootCauseMatrix.contradicting: CPU128/CPU256 remains above 0.001; reference authority is unresolved.
rootCauseMatrix.next: Separate sampling/reference study with validated convergence and blur-spread gates.

rootCauseMatrix.hypothesis: Sample-count radial formula changes all 32-point positions at 64 samples.
rootCauseMatrix.experiment: Exact proposal overlap plus CPU-only nested 64-master alternative vs CPU256.
rootCauseMatrix.actual: Baseline overlap 0/32; nested overlap 32/32; nested64/CPU256 RMSE 0.00620182941685279.
rootCauseMatrix.contradicting: Nested alternative does not improve against CPU256 and is not a qualified reference.
rootCauseMatrix.classification: non-nested proposal behavior confirmed; alternative not promoted
rootCauseMatrix.next: Do not replace production samples from agreement-only evidence.

rootCauseMatrix.experiment: Would stratify error by source gradients, depth edges and occlusion boundaries.
rootCauseMatrix.actual: This run measured matched ROI/global differences but did not stratify by discontinuity class.

rootCauseMatrix.experiment: Matched RGBA16F/RGBA32F outputs and CPU half-bit comparisons.
rootCauseMatrix.contradicting: Full32/64 error remains in F32 and CPU half conversion matches exact stored bits.
rootCauseMatrix.classification: storage precision is secondary, not dominant
rootCauseMatrix.next: Keep internal accumulation precision as a separate untested question.

rootCauseMatrix.experiment: Three repeat captures per native sample profile with matched provenance.
rootCauseMatrix.actual: The earlier report recorded exact comparisons without asserting them. Review Fix 1 explicitly asserted Full32 and Full64 A/B and A/C Far and Near arrays and all were bit-exact.
rootCauseMatrix.supporting: Review Fix 1 native repeatability gate passed across all four Far/Near comparisons.
rootCauseMatrix.contradicting: No instability was observed in the tested capture matrix; this remains bounded to the recorded scene, renderer, device, and captures.

rootCauseMatrix.hypothesis: Fallback broadly substitutes sharp color in meaningfully defocused valid-far pixels.
rootCauseMatrix.experiment: GPU-authored reason taxonomy and expected-blur support.
rootCauseMatrix.actual: 57598 fallbacks; 6 meet blur floor; 57158 are invalid/unresolved centers.
rootCauseMatrix.supporting: Reason taxonomy is complete for the captured surface.
rootCauseMatrix.contradicting: Only six meaningful-blur fallbacks; most are invalid/unresolved center.
rootCauseMatrix.next: Construct matched valid-far meaningful-blur fallback case before any algorithm decision.

rootCauseMatrix.hypothesis: Large relative error is mostly a small-denominator artifact.
rootCauseMatrix.experiment: Absolute/relative pair distributions and denominator floor usage.
rootCauseMatrix.supporting: The floor inflates most relative ratios.
rootCauseMatrix.classification: ratio inflation confirmed but not sole explanation
rootCauseMatrix.next: Keep historical and absolute metrics side by side.

rootCauseMatrix.hypothesis: B1 error is only at fallback edges or proves foreground leakage.
rootCauseMatrix.experiment: Distance-from-boundary error to 8px; directional near-source comparison at valid depth/sign boundaries.
rootCauseMatrix.actual: Difference support reaches 8px analysis limit; depth-edge B1 closer fraction 0.6465074085273662; signed-boundary mean directional delta -0.00004882812500000683.
rootCauseMatrix.supporting: There is a depth-edge directional signal and spatial error beyond the boundary.
rootCauseMatrix.contradicting: Support is truncated at the radius limit; signed signal is near zero; reference unconverged.
rootCauseMatrix.classification: potential directional contamination signal, no causal/visible halo proof
rootCauseMatrix.next: Use a converged reference and controlled foreground-color mutation.

rootCauseMatrix.hypothesis: Center override and rejected off-center geometry explain binary alpha.
rootCauseMatrix.experiment: Actual TSL intermediate readback, independent CPU match, and raw RGBA16F bits.
rootCauseMatrix.actual: 28500 center-Near pixels with 0 accepted proposals; 151146 off-center pixels with 0 accepted proposals; alpha GPU/CPU RMSE 0; half mismatches 0.
rootCauseMatrix.supporting: GPU/CPU decisions and storage match exactly; off-center accepted proposal count is zero.
rootCauseMatrix.contradicting: No app population exercises fractional proposal coverage.
rootCauseMatrix.classification: registered application support limited; no alpha or storage defect observed
rootCauseMatrix.next: Find a registered state with accepted off-center proposals before code changes.

rootCauseMatrix.hypothesis: Coverage formula or binary16 storage makes output binary.
rootCauseMatrix.experiment: Actual TSL on controlled sharp foreground silhouette with different near/far depth and CoC fields.
rootCauseMatrix.actual: 1896 pixels simultaneously outside the silhouette, foreground-colored, and fractional-alpha; selected-center alpha 0.11053466796875 from estimated 0.11058157682418823.
rootCauseMatrix.supporting: Fractional alpha survives RGBA16F and foreground spread is measured.
rootCauseMatrix.contradicting: Synthetic fixture does not qualify public app scene support.
rootCauseMatrix.classification: M5 Near TSL supports fractional alpha; controlled fixture only
rootCauseMatrix.next: Keep app qualification blocked until registered evidence has off-center accepted proposals.

rootCauseMatrix.hypothesis: H-A6 physical footprint or coordinate inputs differ across profiles.
rootCauseMatrix.experiment: Compare current input fingerprints and same-count GPU/CPU results for the same native Q1 state.
rootCauseMatrix.actual: Review Fix 1 matched source, depth, physical, and validity fingerprints; matched-count GPU/CPU RGB RMSE remained below 0.001.
rootCauseMatrix.supporting: The trusted input identity and same-count output checks both passed for this capture matrix.
rootCauseMatrix.contradicting: Evidence covers the tested Architecture Rise state, renderer, device, and ROI only.
rootCauseMatrix.next: Keep exact input and matched-count comparisons as controls; widen evidence before making a general scene or device claim.

nativeAssertions: N1 repeated Full32/Full64 Far/Near captures are bit-exact (passed).
N2 comparison inputs have matching source, depth, physical, and validity fingerprints (passed).
registered-app and native-research-fixture evidence scopes remain distinct
negativeControls.separateM5qConfirmatoryRegression: The separately run native M5Q confirmation retained its frozen per-dimension outcomes and bounded Q3 result; it is not mapped to M5R N16-N18.

recommendation.first: Option A — separate sampling/reference study; require independently validated convergence and blur-spread metrics. The nested CPU-only proposal is not promoted.
recommendation.b1: No B1 rewrite or C1 adoption yet; require a converged reference and controlled valid-far meaningful-blur fallback.
recommendation.near: Find registered-app off-center accepted Near proposals before considering alpha changes.
